title: Skanda Radiology
text: This is Skanda Radiology, tested with actual X-ray, C T, and M R I images. This time, all three examples have reference annotations. We will separate what the model says from where it points. This is synthetic Sarvam narration.

title: X-ray
text: The chest X-ray comes from Chest X Det. The connected model reported atelectasis, which matches one reference category. The reference also includes consolidation, effusion, and fibrosis, which were omitted. No usable reader box or segmentation was returned. The colored heatmap is auxiliary classifier evidence, not a confirmed lesion outline. So this is a partial label match, with localization still unverified.

title: CT
text: For C T, we loaded a labeled liver volume from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon into the existing application. Before inference, we selected three slices containing annotated tumors and one slice without a tumor annotation. The model reported a liver lesion on each positive slice. But the location matters. Green contours show the reference tumors; amber boxes show the model's raw candidates. None of the three boxes overlap the tumor masks. The model also reported a lesion on the reference-negative slice. The application flagged unsupported measurements and withheld those overlays. Finding names alone do not establish correct detection.

title: MRI
text: For M R I, we used a labeled BraTS brain-tumor case, with a post-contrast T one sequence. Again, three reference-positive slices and one reference-negative slice were tested in the app. The model described a focal lesion on all three positive slices, and no abnormality on the negative slice. Spatial accuracy was much weaker. On slice sixty-one, a large box only partly overlaps the reference region and includes substantial unrelated tissue. On slices seventy-five and eighty-five, the boxes miss the reference region completely. A region can pass the application's consistency checks and still be wrong. These results do not demonstrate reliable segmentation.

title: How the comparison was checked
text: The tests used the connected Skanda Q three mixed model. Reference masks were kept out of its inputs. Image dimensions, voxel values, and spatial coordinates were preserved during conversion. The final run checked that each request and result referred to the intended slice. This is four selected slices per volume, not a completed whole-volume assessment. These public training examples may overlap with model training data, so they cannot establish general accuracy.

title: Review the image. Verify the finding.
text: The workspace supports reviewing all three modalities. The labeled tests show why detection and localization must be checked separately. Today, the model results are mixed, and the boxes are not reliable segmentation. Every candidate still needs qualified review.
